note: Banco Unión only: Banco Nacional de Bolivia's site answered 503, Banco Mercantil Santa Cruz's sits behind a captcha, Banco Ganadero's refused the request (403) and BCP Bolivia's tariff page loads its figures by script, giving none to a plain request. Banco Unión's service tariff (21 October 2026) and interest-rate tariff (27 October 2026), read in full: its five personal Visa cards sold to anyone (Internacional, Internacional Mujer, Oro, Platinum and Signature), each with its yearly maintenance cost (charged in four monthly instalments) and its fixed rate in bolivianos, lower the first year and higher after: the first year's rate is written as a twelve-month introductory rate and the later one as the card's rate (the table's columns for the second and third year are printed over each other, and each card has one later figure). A cash advance at a counter or ATM costs 3% of it. The Internacional Convenio (for employers' agreements) and BOOM Funcionario Busa (for staff) cards depend on conditions the game doesn't check, and the Empresarial is a business card, so they aren't written. No minimum payment, grace period, late fee or foreign transaction fee is stated.
